name: potuzhno-drop-demo
description: Potuzhno Drop — transparent virtual CS2 collection game on Cloudflare Workers.

scripts.build:web: npm run build:styles && npm run build:assets
scripts.mobile:sync: npm run build:web && npx cap sync android
scripts.check: node --check js/app.js && node --check src/worker.mjs && npm run build:styles && npm run build:assets && npx wrangler deploy --dry-run
scripts.dev: npm run build:styles && npm run build:assets && wrangler dev
